map: No home on the English wheel at all — desire is not one of its seven.
Only appears on the wheel as ಅಪಹಾಸ್ಯ — laughter aimed at someone.
ದುಃಖ covers the grief; the wheel has no place for grief felt on another's behalf.
Reduced to a single outer petal, ಧೈರ್ಯ, under ಶಕ್ತಿ.
The ninth rasa, added late and argued over. The wheel files peace as a kind of happiness; the rasa tradition makes it a state of its own.
